verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI exposes message history that can be reused to continue a conversation (docs-7), and users note conversations can be serialized to and from JSON (comm-11), so developers can build cross-session persistence themselves. A production user reports that wiring history across turns takes a lot of glue code (comm-14), and the 'context management that survives long sessions' claim (docs-3) covers a single long session, not memory across threads. Missing for 10: a built-in long-term memory store or abstraction, documented persistence of memory across sessions and threads, semantic or recall-based memory retrieval, and independent hands-on corroboration.
